snippet.title: Inversion Day - Reveal Trailer | Wishlist now!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4436240/Inversion_Day/?beta=0

https://inversionday.com/

Invert the world around you in this atmospheric pixel-art puzzle platformer. Escape an alien spaceship with your dog using mysterious artifacts that reshape reality, uncover hidden secrets, and solve increasingly difficult handcrafted puzzles.


Developed by the creator of Beat Saber alongside the game’s former game director — reuniting to create something completely different.
